start_here: Say to your AI: "Book Systems Consultation for <name> at <time>." It runs tool:create-a-tidycal-booking.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of yours: it books one slot on your TidyCal account.
instructions: 0. Get the booking type id with tool:list-my-tidycal-booking-types (its id field).
1. Say to your AI what to book or cancel, with the TidyCal booking type id or booking id.
2. The AI calls tools:run with the tool and its input.
3. Read the answer; the booking is real, so check its time and status.

worked_examples.title: Book a 45-minute Systems Consultation
worked_examples.ask: Book Systems Consultation for Test Booker at 10:00 UTC on 25 November.
worked_examples.given: Reads tools/tidycal/tool-rows.json: a POST to https://tidycal.com/api/booking-types/{booking_type_id}/bookings with the vault key tidycal-api-token. It books a real slot.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answers the new booking: for example booking 12345 for Test Booker starting 2026-11-25 10:00 UTC, with its meeting link.
